gripOrHq.title: Sneak Preview
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: MIT West Tier
gripOrHq.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.

heapOrArchives.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Jack Attack
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner cannot jack out.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Omniscience Foundation
root.rulesText: Give Runner a tag at the end of each turn during which Runner received a tag.

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
